name: Sphere Gallery
description: Full-screen draggable 3D sphere of image tiles with inertia. Clicking a tile rotates it to the front and enlarges it into a centered viewer with a blurred scrim.
contents: Staggered grid of image tiles wrapped around a 3D sphere
Soft edge gradient and blur overlay
behavior: Drag or swipe to rotate the sphere through Hammer.js, with inertia after release
Vertical rotation is clamped to a small polar angle
Click a tile to rotate it to the front and scale it into the viewer, then swap to a high resolution image
Click the scrim to close the viewer
editableByProps: Images, grid size, sphere radius and segment density
Background, tile, gradient and scrim colors
Drag sensitivity, inertia, friction and transition speed
Tile gap and corner radii, blur amount, grayscale, high resolution swap

needsCodeEdit.change: Add captions to tiles or the enlarged viewer
Change viewer frame shape from square
needsCodeEdit.where: data-frame div at the end of the JSX

fixed: Root is a full-screen section with height 100svh and takes over touch gestures on it (touch-none), so page scroll does not start on the gallery on touch devices
Tile placement uses a fixed 2x2 cell size with staggered columns
Enlarged image is created and removed directly in the DOM
